:::{#def-sequence-limit}
#### Limit of a sequence

A [real number](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/number-systems.html#def-real-numbers) $L$ is the **limit** of a [sequence](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-sequence) $(a_n)$ of [real numbers](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/number-systems.html#def-real-numbers)
[@wikipedia_limit_of_a_sequence],
written $\lim_{n \to \infty} a_n = L$ or $a_n \to L$,
if for every $\tolout > 0$ there is a natural number $N$ such that

$$\abs{a_n - L} < \tolout \quad \text{for every } n \ge N.$$

:::
